WITH source_counts AS (
  SELECT p.fundflux, COUNT(DISTINCT p.arcregistry) AS project_count
  FROM scanspatial AS ss
  INNER JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = ss.arcref
  GROUP BY p.fundflux
)
SELECT fundflux,
       project_count,
       project_count::numeric / SUM(project_count) OVER () AS share,
       project_count - AVG(project_count) OVER () AS excess_over_average
FROM source_counts
WHERE project_count > AVG(project_count) OVER ();
